name: connectbhai
description: ConnectBhai monorepo: Next.js frontend + NestJS/Prisma/MySQL backend

scripts.setup: npm --prefix backend ci && npm --prefix frontend ci && npm run db:setup
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm --prefix backend run start:dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm --prefix backend run start:prod" "npm --prefix frontend run start"
